# Development

## Local Workflow

- Use `npm run dev` to run the TypeScript CLI directly with `tsx`.
- Use `npm run build` to compile to `dist/`.
- Use `npm run typecheck` for strict no-emit type checks.

## Key Commands

```bash
npm run dev -- ask "summarize src/application"
npm run build
npm run typecheck
npm test
```

## Code Organization

- `src/index.ts`: process bootstrap and runtime wiring.
- `src/application/`: orchestration logic.
- `src/domain/`: recursive core.
- `src/ports/`: interfaces.
- `src/adapters/`: implementations.
- `tests/`: behavior tests compiled and run from `dist/tests`.

## Extending Tools

1. Implement the relevant port/interface for your tool.
2. Register the tool through extension host wiring and agent configuration.
3. Add/update tests for execution behavior and configuration safety.

## Config Changes

- Update `rlm.config.yaml` for runtime and workflow behavior.
- Keep config values aligned with `src/application/project-config.ts` schema.

## Quality Expectations

- Preserve deterministic CLI behavior (`src/cli/args.ts`, `src/cli/render.ts`).
- Keep recursion constraints explicit and test-covered.
- Avoid hidden side effects in workflow execution paths.
